anchors.description: White cylindrical drum lampshade on the table lamp at left; diameter measured across its widest horizontal extent (left and right silhouette edges at the same height).
anchors.visible_evidence: The white drum shade is clearly visible at upper-left; left and right vertical side edges sit at nearly the same height, so the chord between them is the shade diameter. Its width-to-height ratio (~1.5) matches common 16x10 in drum shades.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Exact shade model unknown; typical drum table-lamp shades are 13-18 in (0.33-0.46 m) in diameter. Assumed a standard 16 in (0.41 m) drum shade.

anchors.description: Front gold/tan decorative throw pillow on the sofa; width measured across its front face between the left and right seams at mid-height.
anchors.visible_evidence: Square decorative throw pillow resting against the sofa back; both side seams are visible at mid-face, giving a chord across the pillow face.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Standard decorative throw pillows are 16-21 in; most commonly 18-20 in (0.46-0.51 m). Exact size/brand unknown.

anchors.description: Second gold/tan throw pillow on the sofa (right of the first); width measured across its visible front face at mid-height.
anchors.visible_evidence: Matching gold throw pillow next to the first against the sofa back; left seam borders the other pillow and its right side is visible against the sofa arm/back.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Same category prior as the matching pillow; 18-20 in typical, exact size unknown.
